operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm source:check && pnpm check:deployment-spec
operations.recovery: Preserve exact source, private secrets, deployment receipts and all applied migration bytes. Stop writes and scheduled dispatch; export DB and FILES before changes. Restore into fresh resources, admit the owner through operator-auth, compare data and file integrity, and verify owner workflows before changing traffic. Reapprove connections, grants and automations explicitly.
